feed.next_up: Implement Wick (349) — Slow Burn: each round deal 1 damage to opponent but lose 1 HP yourself. Pre-roll mutual damage in `doPreRollSetup` following the Haunt/Toxic Fumes tick pattern for the outgoing damage, plus a self-HP cost (1 HP to Wick itself before rolling), with `SLOW BURN!` callout in `var(--uncommon)` — a pyrrhic pressure card that races to Core Melt threshold as a bonus.

feed.summary: Implemented Barnaby (326) — Stubborn: immune to all three opponent-forced switch effects (Winston Scheme in `doWinstonSchemeChoice`, Gus Gale Force in `resolveRound`, Raditz Hunt in `doRaditzHuntChoice`), each showing `STUBBORN!` in `var(--uncommon)` and keeping the battle flowing without deadlock.

feed.summary: Fixed `clearAllOverlays()` missing 4 overlay IDs — `tylerOverlay`, `eloiseOverlay`, `booOverlay`, and `bogeyOverlay` were activatable but never cleaned up on game reset, meaning if Tyler's HP-trade modal, Eloise's HP-swap modal, Boo Brothers' Teamwork modal, or Bogey's reflect-arm modal were open when "New Battle" fired (or the AFK timer triggered), that modal would stay stuck on screen over the team-select view and permanently block the UI. All 4 now properly removed in `clearAllOverlays()`.
feed.next_up: Audit for any other overlay IDs that might have been added in cycles 87–125 and verify they're all in `clearAllOverlays()` — particularly check the `raditzHuntOverlay` and `dougCautionOverlay` (added in Cycles 87–88) to confirm they have proper dismiss/cleanup paths when those modals close mid-battle (e.g., if the battle ends while waiting for Raditz's Hunt decision).
feed.after_that: Look for any remaining implementation gaps in the Rolling Hills/VA set — specifically Igneous (331) Crystallize (no-damage round → +1 Surge) which is a simple win-path resource grant that follows the exact same pattern as Clink Prospect and could be implemented cleanly despite being shelved.
feed.roast: Four modals that could softlock the entire game on reset, shipping six months before Kickstarter, and you're calling this a "fix" instead of "the bare minimum of remembering the cards you designed.

feed.summary: Implemented Ancient Librarian (3) — Knowledge: when AL is the active winning ghost and dmg > 0, counts all 2s rolled by BOTH teams combined and adds +1 damage per 2; `KNOWLEDGE!` queued in `var(--common)` after `BROS!` in the cinematic section with the roll-math shown — so high-die-count opponents (Redd 5-die, Marcus +4 dice) ironically amplify the damage more than small-die builds.
feed.next_up: Implement Puff (5) — Cute: "Enemy doubles and triples do -1 damage." When Puff is the active losing ghost and the winner rolled doubles or triples, reduce incoming damage by 1 (min 0). Add `puffCute` flag in the defensive chain after Sky Elusive; add to Cameron Force of Nature guard; queue `CUTE!` in `var(--common)`.
feed.after_that: Implement Villager (11) — Hospitality: "While on the sideline, the ghost in battle gains +1 health every winning roll." Simple `hasSideline(winTeam, 11)` passive HP grant in the win-path cinematic section using the deferred `onShow` pattern — same as Opa Rest but from the bench.
feed.roast: A punish card that scales with the opponent's dice pool is clever design, but shipping a mechanic named "Knowledge" three weeks from Kickstarter when the real knowledge you need is whether Buttons is still broken feels very on-brand.

feed.summary: Implemented Sandwiches (33) — Dependable: 21 `DEPENDABLE!` mirrors added across the full post-roll queue — every opponent Special gain (14 unique sources: Ashley/Simon/Roger/Humar fire, Spockles/Sad Sal/Gary/Powder ice, Aunt Susan/Farmer Jeff seeds, Dart/Artemis surge, Granny Lucky Stone/Surge/Moonstone in all 6 variants) triggers an equal grant to Sandwiches' team via `sandwichForWin`/`sandwichForLose` flags with deferred `onShow` callbacks.
feed.next_up: Implement the next unimplemented common — check the GHOSTS array for Set 1 commons with `abilityDesc` entries (Ancient Librarian/3, Wanderer/4, Puff/5, Boo/6, Bryce/7, and others in the 1–33 range not yet done) and port whichever has the clearest boobattles reference.
feed.after_that: Continue down remaining Set 1/Dark Castle/Frost Valley commons not yet implemented — use the GHOSTS array `abilityDesc` and boobattles/execution.js to identify each card's trigger pattern, then port faithfully following the established cinematic queue architecture.
feed.roast: Twenty-one mirror hooks to teach a sandwich the word "dependable" — Rosewater calls that "parasitic design," Wyatt, but sure, let's ship a card whose entire identity is a 400-line switch statement two Kickstarters from now.

feed.summary: Implemented Lou (32) — Bros: while on the sideline, Grawr gains +1 Damage and +1 Health on winning rolls — `louBrosTriggered`/`louBrosBaseDmg` in the damage section after Zach Craftsman, `BROS!` queued in `var(--common)` with a deferred `onShow` HP-heal callback (Mr Filbert curse check included), creating a dedicated sustained-fighter synergy between the 7HP Grawr and his 7HP support.
feed.next_up: Implement Sandwiches (33) — Dependable: while on the sideline, whenever the opponent gains a Special (Sacred Fire, Ice Shard, Lucky Stone, Healing Seed, Surge/Moonstone), your team gains the same Special. Add `hasSideline(enemyTeam, 33)` mirrors at every resource-grant point — Dart/Artemis/Spockles ice shards, Ashley/Humar/Simon fire, Aunt Susan/Farmer Jeff seeds, Granny LS, Calvin/Opa overclock HP grants (HP is not a "Special" — only named resources count), queuing `DEPENDABLE!` in `var(--common)` for each mirror.
feed.after_that: Implement the next unimplemented Set 1 commons — Ancient Librarian (3), Wanderer (4), Puff (5), and the rest of the Set 1 commons not yet done. Check the GHOSTS array `abilityDesc` for each and reference boobattles/execution.js for any with existing implementations.
feed.roast: Four months past the September deadline and you're still inventing bro-buff subsystems for a two-card combo that Rosewater would've cut in the first playtest, but sure, Grawr finally has a hype man.

feed.summary: Implemented Dark Wing (76) — Precision: post-roll `#darkWingOverlay` modal (dark purple bat theme) fires when Dark Wing is active and didn't roll doubles; YES rerolls all dice in-place (mutating `B.preRoll[team].dice` so `resolveRound` receives the new values), showing `PRECISION!` in `var(--rare)` with the new array and a 🎯 marker if doubles land; NO keeps current dice — once-per-round via `darkWingUsedThisRound`, wired FIRST in the post-roll chain before Jackson/Sonya/Jeanie.

Add `hasSideline(winTeam, 32)` + `wF.id === 34 && !wF.ko` guard in the win-path cinematic section: deferred onShow callbacks for `wF.hp = Math.min(wF.hp+1, wF.maxHp)` and `dmg += 1` (applied before damage lands via an early damage section guard), with `BROS!` queued in `var(--common)`.
